subject.title: Bug: Agent outputs ~ tilde shorthand instead of full absolute file paths

question: Should OpenClaw keep compact home-path display as the default, add an opt-in absolute-path mode, or change agent/tool output to always show full absolute paths?
rationale: Current code and tests intentionally shorten home paths, the exact opt-in env-var proposal was closed unmerged, and changing the default affects UX, privacy, and display consistency across agent surfaces.

options.title: Keep compact display default
options.body: Leave `~`/`$OPENCLAW_HOME` shortening as the default and close or reframe this as an unsupported preference unless a narrower copy-paste failure is reproduced.

options.title: Add an opt-in absolute mode
options.body: Introduce a documented config or env setting with tests for both default compact display and opt-in absolute output.

options.title: Switch default to absolute paths
options.body: Change prompts and render helpers to emit absolute paths everywhere, with migration notes for the current compact-display behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep compact display default
recommendation.body: Leave `~`/`$OPENCLAW_HOME` shortening as the default and close or reframe this as an unsupported preference unless a narrower copy-paste failure is reproduced.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the central shortening helper and later touched agent tool display behavior, so they are the best available owner for the product-direction choice.
